title: game.resumed
description: server → host and clients. The game continues. Every deadline issued before the pause (…AtMs fields of vote.stage, poll.call, mg.start, console.alert windows, blackout.set, room.state.players[].slotExpiresAtMs) moves later by pausedForMs; receivers shift their local copies and the server does not resend them.

atMs.description: Server clock when the game resumed.

pausedForMs.description: Length of the pause in milliseconds.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
